title: triage input, schema version 1
description: Findings for the triage command-line tool. See docs/input-format.md. The tool also accepts the enumerated values in any letter case; the schema lists the canonical lowercase form.

source.description: Name of the tool or process that produced the findings. Used, with source_id, to recognize the same finding across imports.

source_id.description: Stable ID for this finding in the source tool. Must be unique within the file.

description.description: Longer description. May contain line breaks.

location.description: Where the finding is, in any form (file and line, URL, resource name).

rule.description: Rule, check or weakness ID that produced the finding, such as CWE-89.

cves.description: CVE IDs the finding relates to.

asset.description: System, service or repository the finding belongs to.

exposure.description: How reachable the affected asset is.

asset_criticality.description: How important the affected asset is to the organization.

known_exploited.description: Whether the vulnerability is known to be exploited in the wild, according to a source you trust. Leave out if unknown.

metadata.description: Extra string values to carry through to show and export. Not used for prioritization.
